package upload

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type Handler struct {
	Store   ObjectStore
	MaxSize int64
	Timeout time.Duration
}

type ObjectStore interface {
	Put(name string, r io.Reader, size int64) error
}

func (h *Handler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	name := r.URL.Query().Get("name")
	if name == "" {
		http.Error(w, "missing name", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	body := http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, h.MaxSize)
	defer body.Close()

	hasher := sha256.New()
	if err := h.Store.Put(name, io.TeeReader(body, hasher), r.ContentLength); err != nil {
		var tooLarge *http.MaxBytesError
		if errors.As(err, &tooLarge) {
			http.Error(w, "object too large", http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("store: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"name": name, "sha256": hex.EncodeToString(hasher.Sum(nil))})
}

func retry(attempts int, delay time.Duration, fn func() error) error {
	var err error
	for i := 0; i < attempts; i++ {
		if err = fn(); err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		time.Sleep(delay * time.Duration(i+1))
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("after %d attempts: %w", attempts, err)
}
